status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Contel Ltd (Company number 10871572) is an active private limited company with no parent corporate owner.

claims.claim: In an integrated deployment project with the client Canenco, the company implemented its Defend Connected Live 4G DVR solution integrated with third-party Bartec Collective waste management software to monitor vehicle location and activity across the local authority's grounds maintenance fleet.

In an August 2026 public contract announcement (Reference TD2399), Contel Ltd was awarded a £102,070 contract by a UK authority for an RCV vehicle camera upgrade and installation project to deploy its camera systems and maintain ongoing service across the region's waste fleet.

The company reports that its "Contel AI" fleet platform is built with GDPR compliance at its core, featuring automated face blurring to anonymise footage, role-based access controls, full audit trails, and customisable data retention policies.

The company's Defend Connected Live 4G DVR solution is successfully integrated with Bartec Collective waste management software for the waste, recycling, and grounds maintenance fleet of the client Canenco, as published in an official company case study.

Derby City Council awarded Contel Ltd a £102,070 contract, published in August 2026 and active until May 2027, for a refuse collection vehicle (RCV) camera upgrade and installation project encompassing ongoing data subscriptions and maintenance across its waste fleet.

Contel Ltd was formally listed as an awarded or qualified provider on the KCS Procurement Services Framework for "Vehicle Telematics and Associated Services" in a notice published up to June 2026, positioning the company to supply UK local authorities and public sector bodies.
claims.note: The listing on the KCS Procurement Services Framework for 'Vehicle Telematics and Associated Services' up to June 2026 cannot be verified in available procurement records.

claims.claim: Financial filings registered with the UK Government's Companies House repository indicate that Contel Ltd's total assets grew by 44% to £2.26 million and its cash in bank rose by 30.1% to £962.33K for the 12-month period ending 31 July 2025.
claims.note: The precise growth rates (44% and 30.1%) and the specific cash figure (£962.33K) for the year ending 31 July 2025 cannot be confirmed without the full filing text.

claims.claim: The company reports that it partnered with Dennis Eagle Ltd, Terberg DTS - UK, Bartec, ESPO, and VWS Software Solutions to provide corporate sponsorship and support for an industry event focused on driving sustainability within the local authority sector.
claims.source: Craemer UK Ltd Event Announcement / CIWM & LARAC Midlands Conference Partnership Post

claims.claim: Contel Ltd maintains its primary UK corporate facility at Unit 4 Shorten Brook Drive, Altham Business Park, Altham, Accrington, England.

status.evidence: According to UK Companies House, Kwiktrak (UK) Limited is active and filed its latest confirmation statement on 29 July 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports its Kwiktrak Essentials and Kwiktrak Lite platforms provide real-time turn-by-turn positioning data alongside configured 15-second tracking updates using UK GSM SIM technology.

A deployment at Mainline Haulage Ltd utilizes Kwiktrak's integrated web tracking infrastructure to maintain real-time updates for its office-based "Big Screen" management tools, resulting in a reported 75% reduction in outgoing administrative vehicle-update calls.

The company reports its web-based telematics platform offers real-time turn-by-turn tracking, 15-second updates, historic tracking, geo-fencing, and reporting suites via its Kwiktrak Lite and Kwiktrak Essentials systems, with the latter supporting advanced analytics such as CANBus fuel monitoring and driver behavior analysis.
The company reports supplying three tiers of GPS tracker hardware—Hard-wired, Self-Fit, and Waterproof IP67-rated units—featured on its Kwiktrak UK Website.

The company markets two core tiers of its infrastructure, "Kwiktrak Lite" for basic tracking needs and "Kwiktrak Essentials," which targets large fleets by introducing optional, advanced analytics such as CANBus fuel monitoring and automated remote tachograph downloads.

Mainline Haulage Ltd implemented the Kwiktrak system to track its fleet, which reduced outgoing phone calls by 75%, optimized vehicle ETAs, and integrated tracking data into a centralized office display as detailed by Kwiktrak UK Ltd (https://www.kwiktrak.co.uk/testimonials/).
Mainline Haulage Ltd implemented the "Kwiktrak" tracking system to monitor its haulage fleet, as confirmed by Kwiktrak UK Ltd's customer testimonials (https://www.kwiktrak.co.uk/testimonials/).
The company maintains its registered office facility at Unit 14 Matrix Point, Matrix Way, Buckshaw Village, Chorley, Lancashire, United Kingdom.
